description_en: Restores Internet access for an instance using its virtual IP address (VIP) for graceful recovery in a multi-instance disaster recovery architecture. This operation is available only for Platinum Edition instances. To use this operation, submit a ticket
description_zh: 多实例容灾降级恢复，该接口作用是恢复其中某个实例的公网VIP接入，目前只支持铂金版实例，需要提交工单申请
kebab_example: aliyun onsmqtt disaster-recovery --instance-id mqtt-cn-xxx --recovery-instance-id mqtt-cn-xxx --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DisasterRecovery

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance
parameters.help_zh: 消息队列 MQTT 版实例的 ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to recover
parameters.name: recovery_instance_id

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details that are returned when the access is denied. This field is returned only when the RAM authentication fails
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝详细信息；只有校验RAM失败后，字段才会返回

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates that the call is successful. Other values indicate error codes. For more information about error codes, see Error codes
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码：200：表示成功。                                 其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见错误码

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A value of true indicates that the call was successful. A value of false indicates that the call failed
Success.description_zh: 是否调用成功。true：调用成功。                                 false：调用失败
